title: Performance-Portable Exact Gaussian Process Regression in Python via SYCL and oneMath
abstract: arXiv:2611.17565v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern multi-vendor GPU environments force a choice between portable code and native performance. GPRat is an open-source Python library for exact Gaussian process regression built on the HPX asynchronous many-task runtime, tiled algorithms, and CPU/CUDA BLAS backends. We contribute a UXL Foundation oneMath backend with a hybrid HPX/SYCL design, extending GPRat to AMD and Intel GPUs. The new SYCL backend comes within 3% of native CUDA on an NVIDIA A30 at the largest problem size and outperforms the GPflow and GPyTorch libraries by up to 1.75x and 2.17x on the A30 and up to 1.79x and 4.62x on an AMD Instinct MI210. On an Intel Arc B580, a consumer-class card with FP64 throughput below our CPUs, the unmodified SYCL backend trails GPRat's CPU backend. Overall, oneMath's dispatch to vendor-native BLAS lets a single SYCL codebase match CUDA on NVIDIA and outperform established Python GP frameworks on AMD, without vendor-specific code.

translated_title: 基于SYCL和oneMath在Python中实现性能可移植的精确高斯过程回归
translated_abstract: 现代多厂商GPU环境迫使开发者在可移植代码与原生性能之间做出取舍。GPRat是一个用于精确高斯过程回归的开源Python库，构建于HPX异步多任务运行时、分块算法以及CPU/CUDA BLAS后端之上。我们贡献了一个采用混合HPX/SYCL设计的UXL Foundation oneMath后端，将GPRat扩展到了AMD和Intel GPU。在最大问题规模下，新的SYCL后端在NVIDIA A30上的性能与原生CUDA相差不超过3%，并在A30上比GPflow和GPyTorch库分别最高快1.75倍和2.17倍，在AMD Instinct MI210上分别最高快1.79倍和4.62倍。而在Intel Arc B580（一张FP64吞吐率低于所用CPU的消费级显卡）上，未经修改的SYCL后端则落后于GPRat的CPU后端。总体而言，oneMath对厂商原生BLAS的分发调度，使单一SYCL代码库无需任何厂商专用代码即可在NVIDIA上媲美CUDA，并在AMD上超越成熟的Python高斯过程框架。
tldr: 通过为GPRat高斯过程回归库新增基于oneMath的混合HPX/SYCL后端，单一代码库无需厂商专用代码即可在NVIDIA GPU上媲美原生CUDA性能，并在AMD GPU上最高以4.62倍的速度超越GPflow和GPyTorch等成熟框架，实现了真正的性能可移植性。
en_tdlr: By adding a oneMath-based hybrid HPX/SYCL backend to the GPRat Gaussian process regression library, a single codebase achieves performance portability—matching native CUDA on NVIDIA GPUs and outperforming GPflow and GPyTorch by up to 4.62x on AMD GPUs without any vendor-specific code.
